subject: [hw] DONE V03 rev 2
body:
Rev 2 (no interface change; loader semantics unchanged except one hardening):
1) GNU IFUNC definitions now fail with a named error ("GNU IFUNC symbol is not supported") instead of silently
   binding the resolver address as a callable function. The vendor set has no IFUNC; this only closes a silent-wrong
   path a reviewer could hit.
2) Tests grew: DT_SONAME when soname==NULL (renamed libd.so), DT_INIT through a patched dynamic entry, DT_FINI_ARRAY
   out-of-bounds and bad RELRENT negatives, a malformed GNU hash (bloom shift) negative, describe outside every image,
   and a third vendor run that registers a function shim for all 146 referenced imports (unresolved becomes 0 and all
   3120 GOT/PLT values move to the printed shim addresses).

Last line now:
    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/loader/test_v03/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V03 PASS 12739/12739
(12678 oracle checks per build, ASan+UBSan and -O2, plus 61 hand-built relocation-encoding checks.)
Vendor line: V03 vendor: objects 5, relocations 3120, unresolved 146, unique imports 149
Per object (applied/readelf): vpud 91/91, libvpud_vcodec.so 191/191, libvcodecdrv.so 2162/2162, libvcodec_utility.so 498/498, libvcodec_oal.so 178/178.

Not done is unchanged: RELA/TLS/IFUNC/COPY/GNU_RELRO/unload/FINI execution; unresolved stop reason is STOP_REQUEST
with the name recoverable until V02 accepts NULL fn in n2a32_hostcall_register (fallback in n2elf.c); not compiled for
arm64 iOS; not run on phone. STATUS.md updated in gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V03/ and loader/test_v03/.
